newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: Report values Transmark at NZ$2.00-15/shr.
newsitem.headline: Report values Transmark at NZ$2.00-15/shr.

text.p: Transmark Corp Ltd said on Thursday an independent appraisal by Ernst and Young estimated fair value for its shares at NZ$2.00-$2.15, compared with the $1.60 takeover offer by Gandava Investments Ltd.
The report said the offer was not fair to shareholders. The bid is effectively a management buyout by Transmark Managing Director Nico Wamstaker and interests associated with him.
"In our opinion a fair price for the shares should provide for a pro rata participation in the assessed value of the company, adjusted to reflect the limited market in the shares," the report said.
Transmark, a consumer electronics supplier, last traded at $1.85. -- Wellington newsroom 64 4 4734 746
